versos.hebraico: כִּ֗י הִנֵּ֛ה בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אשוב אֶת־שְׁב֥וּת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
controles.kjv: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
controles.livre: Porque eis que naqueles dias e naquele tempo eu restaurarei Judá e Jerusalém de seu infortúnio.

versos.hebraico: וְקִבַּצְתִּי֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְה֣וֹרַדְתִּ֔ים אֶל־עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֨י עִמָּ֜ם שָׁ֗ם עַל־עַמִּ֨י וְנַחֲלָתִ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּזְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־אַרְצִ֖י חִלֵּֽקוּ׃

controles.web: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
controles.kjv: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
controles.livre: Então ajuntarei todas as nações, e as farei descer ao vale de Josafá; e ali entrarei em juízo com elas por causa do meu povo, e de minha herança Israel, aos quais dispersaram entre as nações, e repartiram minha terra;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־עַמִּ֖י יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ הַיֶּ֨לֶד֙ בַּזּוֹנָ֔ה וְהַיַּלְדָּ֛ה מָכְר֥וּ בַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃

controles.web: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
controles.kjv: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
controles.livre: E lançaram sortes sobre meu povo, e deram os rapazes em troca de prostitutas, e venderam as moças em troca de vinho para beberem.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠גַם מָה־אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן וְכֹ֖ל גְּלִיל֣וֹת פְּלָ֑שֶׁת הַגְּמ֗וּל אַתֶּם֙ מְשַׁלְּמִ֣ים עָלָ֔י וְאִם־גֹּמְלִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ עָלַ֔י קַ֣ל מְהֵרָ֔ה אָשִׁ֥יב גְּמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
controles.kjv: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
controles.livre: Além disso, o que tendes a ver comigo vós, Tiro e Sidom, e todas as regiões da Filístia? Quereis vos vingar de mim? E se quereis vos vingar de mim, apressadamente eu vos retribuirei o pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־כַּסְפִּ֥י וּזְהָבִ֖י לְקַחְתֶּ֑ם וּמַֽחֲמַדַּי֙ הַטֹּבִ֔ים הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
controles.kjv: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
controles.livre: Pois levastes minha prata e meu ouro, e minhas coisas valiosas e boas pusestes em vossos templos,

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכַרְתֶּ֖ם לִבְנֵ֣י הַיְּוָנִ֑ים לְמַ֥עַן הַרְחִיקָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל גְּבוּלָֽם׃

controles.web: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
controles.kjv: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
controles.livre: E vendestes os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Jerusalém aos filhos dos gregos, para os distanciar de sua pátria.

versos.hebraico: הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִן־הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
controles.kjv: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
controles.livre: Eis que eu os levantarei do lugar para onde os vendestes, e retribuirei vosso pagamento sobre vossa cabeça.

versos.hebraico: וּמָכַרְתִּ֞י אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְכָר֥וּם לִשְׁבָאיִ֖ם אֶל־גּ֣וֹי רָח֑וֹק כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

controles.web: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
controles.kjv: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
controles.livre: E venderei vossos filhos e vossas filhas na mão dos filhos de Judá, e eles os venderão aos sabeus, uma nação distante; porque o SENHOR falou.

versos.hebraico: קִרְאוּ־זֹאת֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם קַדְּשׁ֖וּ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הָעִ֨ירוּ֙ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים יִגְּשׁ֣וּ יַֽעֲל֔וּ כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
controles.kjv: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
controles.livre: Proclamai isto entre as nações, convocai uma guerra; despertai aos guerreiros, acheguem-se, venham todos os homens de guerra.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֤תּוּ אִתֵּיכֶם֙ לַֽחֲרָב֔וֹת וּמַזְמְרֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לִרְמָחִ֑ים הַֽחַלָּ֔שׁ יֹאמַ֖ר גִּבּ֥וֹר אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: Beat your plowshares into swords,  and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’
controles.kjv: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
controles.livre: Fazei espadas de vossas enxadas, e lanças de vossas foices; diga o fraco: Sou forte.

versos.hebraico: ע֣וּשׁוּ וָבֹ֧אוּ כָֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וְנִקְבָּ֑צוּ שָׁ֕מָּה הַֽנְחַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.
controles.livre: Ajuntai-vos e vinde, todas as nações ao redor, e reuni-vos. (Ó SENHOR, faze vir ali os teus fortes!)

versos.hebraico: יֵע֨וֹרוּ֙ וְיַעֲל֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֶל־עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם אֵשֵׁ֛ב לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃

controles.web: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
controles.kjv: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
controles.livre: Levantem-se as nações, e subam ao vale de Josafá; porque ali eu me sentarei para julgar todas as nações ao redor.

versos.hebraico: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י בָשַׁ֖ל קָצִ֑יר בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־מָ֣לְאָה גַּ֔ת הֵשִׁ֨יקוּ֙ הַיְקָבִ֔ים כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה רָעָתָֽם׃

controles.web: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
controles.kjv: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
controles.livre: Lançai a foice, porque a colheita já está madura. Vinde, descei; porque o lagar está cheio, os tanques transbordam; porque a maldade deles é grande.

versos.hebraico: הֲמוֹנִ֣ים הֲמוֹנִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶֽחָר֑וּץ כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָרֽוּץ׃

controles.web: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near, in the valley of decision.
controles.kjv: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
controles.livre: Multidões! Multidões no vale da decisão! Porque perto está o dia do SENHOR no vale da decisão.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֖חַ קָדָ֑רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃

controles.web: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
controles.kjv: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
controles.livre: O sol e a lua se escurecerão, e as estrelas recolherão seu brilho.

versos.hebraico: וַיהוָ֞ה מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֗ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ וְרָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיהוָה֙ מַֽחֲסֶ֣ה לְעַמּ֔וֹ וּמָע֖וֹז לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR bramará desde Sião, e dará sua voz desde Jerusalém, e os céus e a terra tremerão; mas o SENHOR será o refúgio de seu povo, e a fortaleza dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם שֹׁכֵ֖ן בְּצִיּ֣וֹן הַר־קָדְשִׁ֑י וְהָיְתָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְזָרִ֥ים לֹא־יַֽעַבְרוּ־בָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃ס

controles.web: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
controles.kjv: So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
controles.livre: Então sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que habito em Sião, o meu santo monte; e Jerusalém será santa, e estrangeiros não mais passarão mais por ela.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִטְּפ֧וּ הֶהָרִ֣ים עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב וְכָל־אֲפִיקֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יֵ֣לְכוּ מָ֑יִם וּמַעְיָ֗ן מִבֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶת־נַ֥חַל הַשִּׁטִּֽים׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters, and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
controles.livre: E será naquele tempo, que os montes destilarão suco de uva, e os morros fluirão leite, e por todos os ribeiros de Judá correrão águas; e sairá uma fonte da casa do SENHOR, que regará o vale de Sitim.

versos.hebraico: מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וֶאֱד֕וֹם לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה מֵֽחֲמַס֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁפְכ֥וּ דָם־נָקִ֖יא בְּאַרְצָֽם׃

controles.web: Egypt will be a desolation, and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
controles.kjv: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
controles.livre: O Egito será uma assolação, e Edom se tornará um deserto assolado, por causa da violência que fizeram aos filhos de Judá, em cuja terra derramaram sangue inocente.

versos.hebraico: וִיהוּדָ֖ה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

controles.web: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
controles.kjv: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
controles.livre: Mas Judá permanecerá para sempre, e Jerusalém de geração em geração.

versos.hebraico: וְנִקֵּ֖יתִי דָּמָ֣ם לֹֽא־נִקֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: I will cleanse their blood, that I have not cleansed: for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”
controles.kjv: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the Lord dwelleth in Zion.
controles.livre: E purificarei o sangue  que não tinha purificado; e o SENHOR habitará em Sião.
